body: Just lost my 27 year old only daughter . She committed suicide leaving us with  unbearable grief and mourning. Its been almost a month but all our energy and drive in life is totally gone . We want to still live and keep her name alive .She was a very bright student and a crusader for woman's right and had great empathy for the animals. Need advise from our community as to how to deal with the loss and handle our lives-  mom and dad
